name: Jjak Mat Chu Gi
summary: Korean 32-tile domino draw-and-discard game where players race to be first to collect three valid pairs.
rules_text: Use a 32-tile Chinese-style domino set. 11 civilian tiles are duplicated; 10 military tiles are singletons that pair by equal pips: 6-3/5-4, 6-2/5-3, 5-2/4-3, 4-1/3-2, and 4-2/2-1 supreme. 2-4 players play anticlockwise. Shuffle face down. First player draws 6 tiles, others 5, rest is face-down reserve. First player may lay any pairs held; if three pairs, wins immediately; otherwise discards one unpaired tile face up. On a turn a player may take the previous discard to complete a pair from hand or draw from reserve, then lay any completed pairs, then discard one tile. First to have three laid pairs wins. In 2-3 player games final pair may not be civilian 6-6; in 4-player it may.
rating_reason: Korean domino draw-and-discard pair-making game, turn-based hidden hands
